BenchmarkExtractThroughput.hardware: GitHub-hosted ubuntu-latest runner (x86_64, 4 vCPU), CI run 34927703066 bench job
BenchmarkExtractThroughput.note: Best of five one-second runs on the runner itself was 10,865,118 rows/sec (T-0177). Recorded at 90% of that so the 20% ceiling in the Makefile (BENCH_REGRESSION_PCT) fails at about 72% of the measured number: shared runners vary run to run and a single-sample baseline at 100% would flag ordinary noise as a regression. The Apple M4 local figure (about 22,000,000 rows/sec) is in docs/PERF.md and is not the gate.
